newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares dip in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares dip in quiet trade.

text.p: Lithuanian shares dipped in dull trade on Wednesday, the bourse said.
The group A index, which tracks the most active stocks on the bourse, fell by 39.25 points to 2621.92 points and turnover on the central market was low at 738,457 litas.
Lithuanian Sea Shipping company fell 9.95 percent to 8.28 litas from 9.14 litas on turnover of 256,718 litas.
"Lithuanian Sea Shipping company was gaining three sessions in a row and today the offer of its shares has increased as a result," Jacikevichius said.
Another loser of the day was Vilniaus Vingis which saw its shares go down to 5.6 litas from 6.22 litas on 15,405 litas.
"According to Lithuania's accounting standards, the company reported earlier it had profit in 1996 but the international audit said the company had a slight loss," Jacikevichius said.
Birzai Milk diary eased to 10 litas from 10.02 on 8,670 litas turnover.
Lithuanian Gas rose to 2.32 litas from 2.30 litas on trade of 59,171 litas.
